issue_context.title: Ability to get industry-standard security identifiers (ISIN, CUSIP etc.) for a given Symbol
issue_context.body:
<!--- This template provides sections for bugs and features. Please delete any irrelevant sections before submitting -->

#### Expected Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the behavior you expect to see for your case. -->
We can get industry-standard security identifies such as ISIN, CUSIP, FIGI and SEDOL for a given Symbol.


#### Actual Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the actual behavior for your case. -->
Not available. It only works the other way around, i.e. we can get a symbol for a given security identifier. 


#### Potential Solution
<!--- Optional. Describe any potential solutions and/or thoughts as to what may be causing the difference between expected and actual behavior. -->
```
 For `QCAlgorithm` & `SecurityDefinitionSymbolResolver`:

We have
public Symbol ISIN(string isin, DateTime tradingDate)
public Symbol SEDOL(string sedol, DateTime tradingDate)
public Symbol CUSIP(string cusip, DateTime tradingDate)
public Symbol CompositeFIGI(string compositeFigi, DateTime tradingDate)

- Add  `SecurityDefinitionSymbolResolver`:
public string ISIN(Symbol symbol)
public string SEDOL(Symbol symbol)
public string CUSIP(Symbol symbol)
public string CompositeFIGI(Symbol symbol)
- Add private static `_securityDefinitionSymbolResolver` in Symbol
    -  add properties `public string ISIN/CUSIP/etc { get; }` 
```

- If not found return `null`, as existing methods
- Add unit tests for each new API method
- Add example algorithm using C#/PY
```
symbol = AddEquity("AAPL").Symbol
symbol.ISIN
symbol.CUSIP
...
```

#### System Information
<!--- Required for Bugs. Include any system specific information, such as OS. -->
QC Cloud
